g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS Batch genomics pipeline on EC2 Spot with FSx for Lustre

g.title: None.None.Node.23
g.text: The lab uploads a sequencing run to S3
An EventBridge rule matches the new run
and starts the Step Functions pipeline
which submits an array job to AWS Batch for each stage
and records the run's progress in DynamoDB
Batch launches EC2 Spot instances in the private subnets of both zones
which pull the pipeline image through the ECR interface endpoint
and read the reads from FSx for Lustre
which loads them from the upload bucket on first access
Results go to S3 through the gateway endpoint
When every stage has finished, SNS tells the researchers
